# Krew / Mesh — Creative Technology Studio
> Independent creative-technology studio combining bold brand identity, spatial UI/UX design, high-performance Next.js web development, 3D WebGL experiences, AI solutions, and SaaS platforms.

## Core Studio Information

- **Website**: https://krewmesh.agency

- **Email**: hello@krewmesh.agency
- **Headquarters**: Nagpur, Maharashtra, India
- **Key Regional Delivery Hubs**: Indore (Madhya Pradesh, India), Pune (Maharashtra, India)
- **Primary Specializations**:
  - Brand Strategy & Visual Identity Design
  - UI/UX Design & Spatial Systems
  - High-Speed Next.js & React Web Development (Sub-second page speeds, 99+ Core Web Vitals)
  - 3D Interactive WebGL & Three.js Experiences
  - Framer Website Design & Motion Development
  - Production AI Integrations & Autonomous Workflow Solutions
  - Full-Stack SaaS Platform Architecture & MVP Development

## Transparent Web Build Packages
- **FASTFORWARD (₹9,999)**: Rapid high-conversion landing page built in Next.js, launch in 48-72 hours.
- **DEEPWEB (₹19,999)**: Multi-page web architecture (up to 10 pages) with custom kinetic animations, blog/CMS integration, and SEO schema.
- **ECOM (₹29,999)**: Full-featured modern e-commerce storefront with cart drawer, UPI/Stripe checkout, and inventory CMS.
- **FULL SEND (₹49,999+)**: Bespoke enterprise web platform, 3D WebGL experiences, custom backend, and AI workflows.
- **Code Ownership**: 100% intellectual property ownership transfer upon completion. No vendor lock-in.

## Key Service Pages
- [Brand Strategy & Visual Identity](https://krewmesh.agency/services/branding): Comprehensive logo systems, typography, color architecture, and brand guidelines.
- [UI/UX & Spatial Product Design](https://krewmesh.agency/services/design): User research, wireframing, high-fidelity prototypes in Figma, and design systems.
- [High-Performance Web Development](https://krewmesh.agency/services/development): Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and edge hosting.
- [Digital Marketing & Conversion Systems](https://krewmesh.agency/services/digital): SEO optimization, performance marketing funnels, and analytics.
- [AI Automation & Custom Intelligence](https://krewmesh.agency/services/ai): Custom LLM integrations, conversational agents, and internal tooling.
- [SaaS Platforms & Web Applications](https://krewmesh.agency/services/saas): Scalable multi-tenant web apps, authentication, databases, and billing.
